title: Hai Mera Naam Sakina
body:
Dee'n Ki Pehchaa'n Mera Baba
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
kulle Imaa'n Mera Dada
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe Maaro Na Tamaacha
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Rabbe Akbar Ki Shab O Roz Namazei'n Padhkar
apne Mabood Se Har Waqt Duayei'n Kar Kar
mujhe Shabbir (as) Ne Paaya
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Naaz Bachpan Se Uthate Hain Chacha Jaan Mere
mujhko Godi Mein Khilaate Hain Chacha Jaan Mere
inke Baazu Mera Jhoola
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mere Munkir Mere Dushman Ko Bataado Khulkar
saniye Zehra (sa) Ka Us Waqt Sahaara Bankar
maine Islaam Bachaaya
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Main Hoon Baba Ka Sukoo'n Mera Sukoo'n Hai Asghar. (as)
aye Azadaaro Meri Qabr Pa Aana Ho Agar
nouha Asghar (as) Ka Sunaana
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baad Baba Ke Yatimi Ne Sataaya Mujhko
shimr L.a Ne Maarke Durro Se Rulaaya Mujhko
maine Har Zulm Uthaaya
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Humko Kaanto Pa Chalaya Gaya Sehrao'n Me
dard Sajjad (as) Ko Hota Tha Jo'nhi Chaalo Me
maine Kaanto Ko Nikaala
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Imtehaa'n Leta Hai Ulfat Ka Meri Baniye Shar
kaha'n Darbaare Layee'n Aur Kaha'n Aapka Sar
aa Meri Goud Me Aaja
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Waqte Aaqir Hai Mera Sunlo Wasiyat Bhayya
mere Laashe Ko Kisi Thandi Jagah Dafnaana
maine Paani Nahi Paaya
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Asghari Jab Bhi Kahi Hogi Jo Majlis Meri
sath Dadi Ke Waha Mai Bhi Chali Aaongi
meri Taskeen Hai Pursa
<<MINI>>
Hai Mera Naam Sakina (sa)
